description: Na₁₅S₅Cl(O₅F)₄ crystallizes in the trigonal P31m space group. There are ten inequivalent Na sites. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 9-89°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.54 Å. The Na-Cl bond length is 2.70 Å. The Na-F bond length is 2.25 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four O and two F atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.53 Å. There is one shorter (2.30 Å) and one longer (2.42 Å) Na-F bond length. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to four O and two F atoms to form NaO₄F₂ octahedra that share corners with three NaO₄F₂ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₄F₂ pentagonal pyramid, corners with four SO₄ tetrahedra, edges with four NaO₄F₂ octahedra,  a faceface with one NaClO₄F octahedra, and  a faceface with one NaO₄F₂ pentagonal pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 15-77°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.45-2.53 Å. There is one shorter (2.26 Å) and one longer (2.37 Å) Na-F bond length. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 8-75°. There are three shorter (2.42 Å) and one longer (2.46 Å) Na-O bond length. Both Na-F bond lengths are 2.34 Å.
